duas.title: For Good in This Life and the Next
Refuge from the Whispers of Shayateen
For Anxiety and Grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Main tere paas panah maangta hoon fikr aur gham se, na-taqati aur susti se, buzdili aur kanjoosi se, karz ke bojh se aur logon ke ghalba (dabao) se.

duas.title: When Angry
duas.translation: Main dhutkare hue shaytan se Allah ki panah maangta hoon.

duas.title: Upon Waking Up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne hamein maut (jaisi neend) ke baad zinda kiya, aur usi ki taraf lautna hai.

duas.title: Before Sleeping
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Tere naam se main marta hoon aur jeeta hoon.

duas.title: Before Eating
duas.note: If you forget to say it before starting, say "Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih" (In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end) as soon as you remember.

duas.title: After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe ye khilaya aur bina meri kisi taqat-o-qoowat ke mujhe ye rizq diya.

duas.title: Entering the Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi Rabbina tawakkalna
duas.translation: Allah ke naam se hum andar aaye, aur Allah ke naam se hum bahar jaate hain, aur apne Rab Allah hi par hamara bharosa hai.
duas.note: Followed by greeting the household with Salam.

duas.title: Leaving the Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'ala Allahi wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: Allah ke naam se, maine Allah par bharosa kiya, aur Allah ke siwa koi taqat aur qoowat nahi.

duas.title: Entering the Masjid
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Mere liye apni rahmat ke darwaze khol de.

duas.title: Leaving the Masjid
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Main tujh se tera fazl (fazl-o-karam) maangta hoon.

duas.title: Entering the Bathroom
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Main tere paas naapak jinnaat, mard aur aurat, dono se panah maangta hoon.

duas.title: Leaving the Bathroom
duas.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 30; Sunan Ibn Majah 300

duas.title: Wearing New Clothes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Sari tareef teri hai, tu ne hi mujhe ye pehnaya hai. Main is ki bhalai aur is ke maqsad ki bhalai maangta hoon, aur is ki buraai aur is ke maqsad ki buraai se panah maangta hoon.

duas.title: On Sighting the New Moon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu Akbar. Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu Rabbana wa tarda. Rabbuna wa Rabbukal-lah
duas.translation: Allah sab se bada hai. Aey Allah! Is chaand ko hum par amn-o-iman, salamati aur Islam, aur un kaamon ki taufeeq ke saath tulu farma jinhein hamara Rab pasand aur pasand karta hai. Hamara aur tera Rab Allah hai.

duas.title: When Sneezing
duas.translation: Sari tareef Allah ke liye hai.
duas.note: Those who hear it should reply "Yarhamukallah" (Allah have mercy on you); the sneezer then replies "Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum" (May Allah guide you and set your affairs right).

duas.title: Upon Hearing of a Calamity or Death
After Reciting Istirja (Following the Verse Above)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-jurni fi museebati wakhluf li khayran minha
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Mujhe meri museebat mein ajr (sawab) de aur mujhe iske badle behtar ata farma.

duas.title: For the Deceased (Salat al-Janazah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li hayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa sagheerina wa kabeerina, wa dhakarina wa unthana
duas.translation: Aey Allah! Hamare zinda aur hamare murda ko, hamare hazir aur hamare ghaib ko, hamare chhote aur hamare bade ko, hamare mard aur hamari aurat ko bakhsh de.

duas.title: Consoling the Bereaved
duas.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhadh, wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi-ajalin musamma, faltasbir wal-tahtasib
duas.translation: Jo Allah ne liya wo usi ka tha, aur jo usne diya wo bhi usi ka tha, aur har cheez ka uske paas ek muqarrar waqt hai. Pas sabr karo aur sawab ki neeyat rakho.
duas.note: The Prophet ﷺ sent this message to his own daughter when her son was dying.

duas.title: Visiting a Grave
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: Assalamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin, wa inna in sha'a Allahu bikum lahiqun, as'alullaha lana wa lakumul-'afiyah
duas.translation: Salamati ho tum par, aey qabron walon, momino aur musalmano! Aur be-shak hum bhi, Allah chahe to, tumse aa milne wale hain. Main Allah se hamare aur tumhare liye aafiyat maangta hoon.
